			hidden_trigger = {
				COLDWAR_FRA_national_government = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_earned }
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_a_followup_earned
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_armament_national_b_followup_earned
				}
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_a_earned }
			}
			nationalist_right_wing_populists_are_in_power = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dlc = "No Step Back"
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_research_available_0
					is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_armoured_vehicle_project
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = mbt_tech_1 }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_research_available_1
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_tech = MBT_2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b"
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_political_power = -75
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dlc = "No Step Back"
					}
					add_tech_bonus = {
						name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_award
						bonus = 0.5
						uses = 1
						technology = mbt_tech_1
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_dlc = "No Step Back" }
					}
					add_tech_bonus = {
						name = COLDWAR_FRA_research_national_b_award
						bonus = 0.5
						uses = 1
						technology = MBT_2
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_FRA_apply_research_national_b = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}
}
